tasks.content: Create comprehensive architecture documentation explaining the voice-first design patterns, SSE flow, and tool integration.
Write step-by-step deployment guide for production environment including Vercel setup, Tavus configuration, and environment variables.
Document common issues, debugging steps, and monitoring practices for voice pipeline and data API integration.
Generate WCAG AAA compliance report with evidence of 7:1 contrast ratios, semantic HTML usage, and screen reader compatibility.
Document performance metrics including bundle size, SSE latency, tool response times, and concurrent user capacity.
Create migration summary highlighting changes from previous implementation, breaking changes, and benefits achieved.
